question: On WebArena-Verified v2 36 families >=3 (192 tasks, 49 templates, duplication 0.9479, param_task 0.8958) with controlled novelty fraction 0/25/50/75/100% (train on resource A, test on never-observed B within same family), does later-agent cost (tokens, browser interactions, retrieval+reconstruction+verification+repair amortized at f=10) track residual novelty (Spearman rho_novelty >0.6, R2_delta >0.5) rather than full task length (rho_length per stratum |r|<0.20) when SPIDER parameterized inheritance (kernel distill_parameterized with Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor, freshness gating 0.25, calibrated UNKNOWN <0.80, ECE<=0.15) is measured with genuine execution (not bijective formula) vs COLD vs instructions vs RAG-EMBED vs Stagehand DOM-hash serverCache vs TERX 0-token replay, reporting family-stratified bootstrap CIs, false_accept<=0.10, UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, and honest amortized saving >=25% vs cold?
hypothesis: Later-agent cost under SPIDER parameterized inheritance (Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor slot induction, behavioral freshness gating 0.25, confidence-gated UNKNOWN <0.80 with ECE<=0.15, verification+repair) tracks residual novelty fraction n in [0.0,0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00] (train on resource A, test on never-observed B within same WebArena-Verified v2 family) with Spearman rho_novelty >=0.60 (block-permutation p<0.01, family-stratified bootstrap CI lower >0.35) and R2_novelty - R2_length = R2_delta >=0.50 (R2_novelty >=0.30, R2_length approx 0), while cost vs full task length within each novelty stratum is flat (rho_length per stratum |r|<0.20). At n=0.0 SPIDER is >=25% cheaper amortized at f=10 than B-COLD and within parity of strong caching (Stagehand/TERX) at exact repeat, and beats B-RAG-EMBED/B-INSTRUCTIONS at low novelty; at n=1.0 SPIDER via calibrated UNKNOWN fallback is not more than 10% worse than COLD (false_accept<=0.10, UNKNOWN precision>=0.85). Null is flat cost vs novelty (rho~0, R2_delta~0) or no honest saving vs strong baselines.
falsifier: FALSIFIED if primary novelty-tracking fails while controls pass: (F1) Spearman rho_novelty <0.35 or p>=0.05 or R2_delta <0.15 (and specifically <0.50 fails Director threshold) indicating cost does not increase with residual novelty; or (F2) residual-novelty model not better than length: R2_novelty <=0.30 or rho_length per stratum |r|>=0.20 suggesting length explains cost; (F3) honest amortized saving at f=10 vs B-COLD at n=0.0 is <25% (SPIDER/COLD >0.75) or SPIDER more expensive than COLD at n=1.0 by >10% (ratio >1.10) indicating no work compression; (F4) false_accept >0.10 or UNKNOWN precision <0.85 or ECE>0.15 indicating miscalibrated inheritance; (F5) SPIDER not beating B-STAGEHAND-CACHE (2x/~30% baseline) nor B-RAG-EMBED/B-TERX at low novelty where they hit, indicating caching/retrieval dominates. MIXED if correctness holds (F4 false) but F1/F2 fail: mechanisms execute but cost flat (constant overhead dominates, e.g., retrieval/verification not amortized). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if positive controls fail (exact-repeat not 0-token-like, binding error >0.20), bijective formula detected, registry never consulted/UNKNOWN never exercised, or baselines starved (Stagehand/TERX hit_rate 0 at n=0 inside compared set).

baselines.description: Cold start with no SPIDER memory: simulated or real LLM (gpt-4o-mini if key available, else deterministic token proxy 500 tok + 2 browser calls per novel step) explores each task from scratch. No retrieval, no reconstruction. Upper-bound full-length cost. Runs on identical 192-task family-stratified splits.
baselines.expected: Cost flat vs novelty (rho~0) at ~full length * unit cost. Success baseline for honest saving denominator at f=10. Amortized cost = per-task exec / success.

baselines.description: Site-specific hand-authored instructions baseline (strong instruction prompt describing WebArena family template, no retrieval/reconstruction). Same LLM/budget/tools as SPIDER. Cost = instruction tokens (200 amortized at f=10 -> 20) + full exploration of identifier-specific steps. Tests instructions alone without parameterized mechanism.
baselines.expected: Cost slightly below B-COLD but still near full length; not novelty-proportional. Expected to be beaten by SPIDER at low novelty by >=15% amortized.

baselines.description: Semantic retrieval RAG-EMBED over prior A trajectories: embedding cosine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 offline deterministic if available, else TFIDF Jaccard fallback) retriever over intent+template; top-1 then verbatim bind (no reconstruction) with verification fallback to B-COLD for mismatched slots. Fit on train registries only. Strong memory baseline per architecture requirement that memory must beat memory. Retrieval cost 200 tok +150ms per task.
baselines.expected: At n=0.0 hit_rate~1.0 (exact set match by construction) cost near SPIDER/Stagehand; at >=25% novelty worse than SPIDER because without parameterization every novel identifier triggers fallback. SPIDER expected to beat by >=20% at n=0 and n=0.25 amortized f=10.

baselines.description: Stagehand DOM-hash serverCache (Feb 2026 exact-selector+DOM-hash 2x speedup, ~30% cost) baseline: DOM-hash + exact selector cache with structural validation. Hit iff DOM structure identical (n=0.0 exact repeat, structural drift absent); on semantic drift (auth/body/query aliasing) hash validation misses and falls back to B-COLD LLM exploration. Hit cost ~30% of COLD (verification 50 tok +120ms), miss cost = COLD. This is the shipped competitive falsifier SPIDER must beat before claiming compression.
baselines.expected: Hit_rate=1.0 at n=0.0 -> 2x speedup ~30% cost; at 100% novelty hit_rate=0 -> COLD. At mixed header+body+query aliasing, expected to miss where SPIDER reconstruction hits. SPIDER expected cheaper than Stagehand at n>=0.25 where structural hash fails but semantic parameterization succeeds.

baselines.description: TERX/BrowserBash 0-token exact replay with LLM fallback: if test task's full identifier/parameter sequence exactly equals a training trajectory (n=0.0 exact repeat), replay at 0 LLM tokens + 50 tok verification + 1 browser call ~90-120ms; otherwise replay fails and falls back to B-COLD LLM exploration for full task. Strongest exact-repeat economics (23k->0 tokens, 173x speedup baseline). Hit_rate by construction 1.0 at n=0, 0 at n=1.0 inside compared set.
baselines.expected: At n=0 hit cost ~50 tok << SPIDER (SPIDER allowed within 2x at 0%); at n>=0.25 hit_rate low -> COLD. SPIDER expected cheaper than TERX at n>=0.25 where exact replay misses but parameterized binding succeeds.

baselines.description: PRODUCT SYSTEM UNDER TEST: SPIDER parameterized inheritance via kernel distill_parameterized with Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor (field-path-relevant, structure-similarity >=0.75 as validated in 33741671686/35132898840), behavioral freshness gating 0.25 (JWT/mock probe 0.8 on 401/403 vs 0.0 on 200), confidence = softmax over candidate scores temp 0.15 + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN when max_score<0.80 (not hardcoded, ECE<=0.15, std>0.05), verification of bound_action against postconditions with repair cost (1 LLM step) on failure, fallback to COLD on UNKNOWN (honest abstention). Registry via MechanismRegistry, bound via _bind, amortized cost = (retrieval 200+verify 50+exec/repair) / success with distill 1000/f added only to SPIDER. Genuine execution: cost summed from executed branches per task, not bijective formula M=250+500*novelty.
baselines.expected: At n=0 pooled success >=0.85, reused fraction >=0.90, cost ~C_fixed (retrieval+verify) << COLD (>=25% saving at f=10, within 2x of TERX/Stagehand). At n=1 UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, cost via fallback <=1.10x COLD, false_accept<=0.10. Novelty tracking rho>=0.60, R2_delta>=0.50, rho_length per stratum |r|<0.20.

positive_control.description: Two positive controls: (PC1) Exact-repeat literal mechanism: training resource A mechanism replayed on same resource A with n=0.0 (exact repeat sequence) via TERX and Stagehand must achieve hit_rate 1.0 inside compared set, 0 LLM tokens + ~50 tok verification + 1 browser call, success 1.0, reused>=0.95. Validates substrate can measure 0-cost caching case and that n=0 tasks are retrievable (not starved). (PC2) Parameterized inheritance on seen identifiers: SPIDER distill_parameterized trained on 5 observations of family resource A must resolve EXECUTABLE with correct bound_action via _bind on same A set at n=0 (5/5 per family spot-check) with binding correctness 1.0, confirming slot induction works before testing generalization to B. Failure of either indicates substrate broken -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Split controls: PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH not required (WebArena census is file-based, not live BrowserGym), but if Playwright is used for browser interactions, report health >=80% with AX nodes>10 else exploratory.
positive_control.expected_behavior: PC1: B-TERX-REPLAY and B-STAGEHAND-CACHE at n=0 cost =50 tok verification only, hit_rate 1.0, success 1.0. PC2: SPIDER at n=0 via actual distill_parameterized/_bind achieves correct binding on held A set 5/5 per family spot-check, success>=0.95, reused>=0.90. Failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not falsification.

null_control.description: Three null controls: (NC1) Shuffled parameter-slot mapping: randomly permute learned slot->identifier binding (swap ${sku} with ${store_id}) before SPIDER resolve on same 192 tasks via actual registry/_bind/verify pipeline. Expect Spearman |rho|<0.25 p>=0.05 and success <= B-COLD, proving observed novelty tracking requires correct parameterization not any reuse. (NC2) Random mechanism selection: SPIDER retrieval returns random registry entry instead of ranked match, UNKNOWN disabled, via actual ranking path. Expect false_accept>=0.30 and flat cost vs novelty |rho|<0.25. (NC3) Length-proportional fail-able control B-LENGTH-PROPORTIONAL: cost = task length * unit cost regardless of novelty (flat vs novelty by construction) must show |rho|<0.25 and R2_novelty<0.15, proving environment can express MIXED/FALSIFIED not only SURVIVES (addresses prior unreachable falsifier).
null_control.expected_behavior: NC1 rho |rho|<0.25 non-significant, success collapse. NC2 false_accept>=0.30. NC3 rho~0, R2~0. If NC1 spuriously shows rho>=0.35 significant, novelty label is confounded with difficulty -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

measurement_validity: 1. WebArena-Verified v2 census fidelity: Use replicated census of 192 tasks across 36 families >=3 (49 templates, duplication 0.9479, param_task 0.8958) as enumerated in research portfolio. Attempt to load fixtures from /tmp/webarena or repo-cached JSON manifest; if unavailable generate synthetic family-structured mock replicating exactly 36 families, 49 templates, duplication and param_task ratios and log provenance, disclosure ceiling as synthetic/WebArena-inspired mock. Task intents and accessibility-tree fragments imported per EXP-INTEL-35651934683 if available; otherwise mock intents are template-parameterized catalog flows (L variable 8-14 steps, family-specific workflow search->filter->open->select->add->checkout->verify with family-specific parameter slots ${sku}, ${store_id}, ${variant}, ${category}). Manifest, source identifiers, hashes, seeds logged.

2. Controlled novelty hold-out within family: For each of 36 families, partition resource identifiers into disjoint A (train) and B (test never-observed) pools with zero overlap. Controlled fractions n in {0.0,0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00} are realized by sampling test tasks where n fraction of parameterizable identifier slots are drawn from B and (1-n) from A, deterministically stratified by slot position and family. n=0.0 tasks are exact-repeat sequences (test sequence equals a training trajectory) so B-TERX/B-STAGEHAND hit_rate=1.0 is reachable inside compared set (honest accounting, fixes prior 0/100 starvation). Train uses 5 demonstrations per family on A only; registry stores one parameterized mechanism per family via actual distill_parameterized (Jaccard>=0.75 constant-anchor, field-path-relevant) not hard-coded constant. Registry via MechanismRegistry write/read exercised and hashed. All preprocessing (TFIDF/embedding fit, distill induction) on TRAIN only.

3. Full task length co-variation disclosure: Length L is family-specific (8-14) and constant within family but varies across families; this permits testing rho_length per stratum |r|<0.20 while isolation at L=10 fixed is not assumed. Report per-family length distribution, duplication, and param_task. Novelty fraction n and length L are orthogonal by design within strata; bootstrap respects family grouping. If length and novelty are confounded (ANOVA interaction p<0.05), disclose as validity caveat and report within-stratum rho_length.

4. SPIDER mechanism executed, not formula-defined: harness-level or committed src/spider/kernel.py distill_parameterized with _extract_varying_values logic, Jaccard>=0.75, constant-value anchor, structure-similarity >=0.75, field-path relevance filter, behavioral freshness probe (Flask JWT mock HS256 0.8 on 401/403 vs 0.0 on 200 threshold 0.25) and confidence softmax temp 0.15 + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN <0.80 (std>0.05, ECE computed 5 bins, bootstrap CI). At test time resolve(intent, context, params) via actual SpiderKernel.resolve checking required_slots = set(parameter_slots) | template_slots, freshness >=0.25 -> UNKNOWN, confidence<0.80 -> UNKNOWN, bound via _bind, verification against postconditions, repair cost (500 tok +2 calls) on verification failure. Success/false_accept/UNKNOWN/reused_steps are verification-derived with genuine variability, so rho can be <1 and C3/MIXED falsifiable. Cost is sum of executed branches (retrieval 200 tok +150ms, verify 50+120ms, novel/failed step 500+2 calls, repair 500+2 calls) not 250+500*int(10n). Distill amortized 1000/f added only to SPIDER (f=10 primary), instruction tokens 200/f correctly. If gpt-4o-mini + Playwright available (15 steps, 4096 tokens, temp 0 seed 42), measure real tokens/browser interactions and add proxy sensitivity ±50% in report appendix.

5. Strong baselines on identical splits with honest accounting and retrievability: All baselines run on same 192 tasks with same proxy/verification logic and same fallback to B-COLD for miss. B-RAG-EMBED uses offline embedding cosine (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 if available else Jaccard TAU=0.30) and is retrievable by construction at n=0 (overlap 1.0) and proportionally at n=0.25. B-STAGEHAND-CACHE uses DOM-hash exact-selector cache (2x/~30% at hit) with hit logic DOM-hash identical at n=0. B-TERX exact string equality hit logic. None starved; hit_rate at n=0 reported and must be 1.0 in main set. Distill added only to SPIDER; instruction correctly amortized.

6. Calibration and abstention measured, not assigned: UNKNOWN precision = TP_UNKNOWN / (TP+FP_UNKNOWN) where UNKNOWN is correct when no applicable mechanism or gated <0.80 and verification would fail; false_accept = EXECUTABLE with wrong binding that fails verification. Both derived from verification outcomes, not hash-assigned constants. ECE computed over 5 confidence bins using derived confidence (softmax+jitter) with 3 empty bins disclosed if present; bootstrap 2000 for ECE CI; reported per stratum and pooled. Thresholds: false_accept<=0.10 overall, UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, ECE<=0.15. If proxy, ECE is calibration of derived confidence vs correctness within task.

7. Statistics: primary novelty-tracking test is Spearman rho between per-task SPIDER amortized cost at f=10 and novelty_fraction n (family-stratified, N~192, block-permutation p primary exact via family label permutation or 5000 bootstrap, two-sided p<0.01). Power >0.95 to detect rho>=0.60 at alpha 0.01 (requires n>=44). Family-stratified bootstrap 5000 resamples (resample families with replacement, then tasks within family) for 95% CI on rho, R2_delta, cost ratios and rho_length, respecting dependency structure. Linear regressions cost~novelty and cost~length per stratum report slope, p, R2, with heteroscedasticity-robust SE. Report all CIs with degenerate handling (if variance 0, CI flagged degenerate, not precision claim).

8. Holdout and contamination: No test B identifier appears in train registry verbatim (verify 0 hit outside controlled n=0 exact repeats); TFIDF/embedding fit on train registry only; distill induction from A only; reconstruction/retrieval derived from train only; hidden_expected template not passed to any method except verification after resolve. Audit checks no method accesses hidden_expected or test B verbatim except via params binding. Family holdout is strict (train family A pool never sees B).

9. Sampling and determinism: Deterministic seeds (PYTHONHASHSEED=0, random.seed 42, numpy RandomState 42) for all sampling and jitter. Each task evaluated once per method (paired design); bootstrap resampling CIs are primary uncertainty, not post-hoc jitter inflation. Browser/Playwright calls if used are at 1280x720 viewport with CDP AX tree hash + truncated snapshot for parsing, deterministic. No outcome-bearing measurement before freeze.

10. Prereg freeze and provenance: prereg.md and spec.json frozen via freeze.json before any outcome-bearing measurement; code (src/spider/kernel.py distill_parameterized hash, registry.py, models.py), fixtures (WebArena census manifest hash, family/task JSON hashes), decision thresholds, proxy constants, BrowserGym/Playwright version pin, embedding model name, and decision rule hashed in freeze.json. Deterministic seeds logged. Raw evidence preserved: per-task CSV with task_id, family_id, novelty_fraction, length, system, success, false_accept, unknown, precision, tokens, browser_calls, latency_ms, reused_steps, hit, verification_passed, repair_triggered, confidence, ECE bin, plus registry JSONL per family, cost_config.json, branch_traces.json. Provenance with run id, commits, run hashes, artifact SHA256.
decision_rule: All primary thresholds on family-stratified pooled N~192 unless stated; live not required (file-based WebArena census, not BrowserGym). Compute per-method success, false_accept, UNKNOWN precision, ECE 5-bin, cost per task and amortized cost per success at f=10 (distill 1000/f only SPIDER, instruction 200/f), Spearman rho_novelty, R2_novelty, R2_length per stratum and pooled R2_delta, rho_length per stratum, Wilson 95% CI for rates, family-stratified bootstrap 5000 for rho/R2/ratio CIs, block-permutation p for rho. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (C1) correctness+calibration: SPIDER success at n=0.0 >=0.85 (Wilson lower >=0.72) and mean success across n bins >=0.80 with false_accept<=0.10 overall and UNKNOWN precision>=0.85 and ECE<=0.15 (5 bins, derived confidence std>0.05, 3 empty bins disclosed) – all verification-derived; (C2) positive controls: PC1 B-TERX and B-STAGEHAND hit_rate 1.0 at n=0 inside compared set with 50 tok verification-only cost and success 1.0, PC2 SPIDER binding correctness 5/5 per family spot-check at n=0 via actual _bind; failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID; (C3) novelty tracking: Spearman rho_novelty >=0.60 with two-sided block-permutation p<0.01 and family-stratified bootstrap 95% CI lower >0.35, slope>0 p<0.01; (C4) residual-novelty explanatory power: R2_delta = R2_novelty - R2_length >=0.50 per Director (with R2_novelty>=0.30 reported) and rho_length per novelty stratum |r|<0.20 (all 5 strata); (C5) work compression honest: amortized SPIDER/COLD at f=10 <=0.75 at n=0.0 (>=25% saving) and at n=0.0 <=1.20x B-STAGEHAND-CACHE cost (within 20% of shipped cache at exact repeat) and SPIDER beats B-RAG-EMBED at n=0.0 and n=0.25 (ratio<=0.80) and beats B-TERX at every n>=0.25 (cost_SPIDER < cost_TERX at 0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00 at f=10); at n=1.0 SPIDER/COLD <=1.10 via UNKNOWN fallback; (C6) null controls: NC1 shuffled |rho|<0.25 p>=0.05 and success<=B-COLD, NC2 random false_accept>=0.30 or |rho|<0.25, NC3 B-LENGTH-PROPORTIONAL |rho|<0.25 R2_novelty<0.15 (demonstrates falsifiable environment). FALSIFIED if C3-C6 fail while C1-C2 PASS (valid negative). MIXED if C1 passes but C3 or C4 fail (correct but cost flat -> constant overhead dominates, retrieval/verification not amortized). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if C1/C2 fail due to harness/binding errors (success<0.50 at n=0 for all, binding error>0.20, hit_rate at n=0 <0.90 where hits by construction), bijective formula detected (cost == 250+500*novelty with rho=1.0 degenerate CI [1,1]), registry never consulted/UNKNOWN never exercised (UNKNOWN 0 at n=1.0 by construction), or infrastructure failure (registry I/O, mock unreachable, embedding model missing and no fallback).
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES family-stratified: C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY advances from HYPOTHESIS to EXPERIMENTAL (bounded: WebArena-Verified v2 file-based census 192 tasks/36 families file/mock as logged, token/browser proxy or gpt-4o-mini 15-step Playwright where available, harness or committed kernel distill_parameterized Jaccard>=0.75). Provides first direct non-bijective evidence that later-agent amortized cost tracks residual novelty (rho>0.6, R2_delta>0.5) not full length (|r|<0.20) with calibrated abstention (false_accept<=0.10, UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, ECE<=0.15) and honest saving >=25% vs cold at f=10 beating retrievable RAG-EMBED and shipped Stagehand DOM-hash serverCache (2x/~30%) at >0% novelty and TERX at >=25%. This unblocks C-PRODUCT-ECON honest amortized economics scale-up to Docker full-DOM hosting + real LLM measurement (Intel sample-level overlap + Runtime distributed replication become next prerequisites with measured effect size), justifies parameterized inheritance as commercial viability lever despite Stagehand 2x dominance at exact repeat, and provides effect-size prior for f=100 amortization. No PRODUCT_CORE promotion yet; replication with production WebArena Docker hosting + real LLM tokens + kernel-committed distill required before promotion.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED (controls PASS but rho<0.35 or R2_delta<0.15 or saving <25% or not beating Stagehand/RAG/TERX where they honestly hit): parameterization as ported does not yield residual-novelty-proportional work compression on tested WebArena-Verified v2 family hold-out (header/body/auth/query within family), or only by inflating false_accepts/miscalibration, or constant overhead dominates (MIXED). Product must NOT claim pay-cost-of-novelty on this DGP for C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON; keep exact-intent or per-site mapping; prioritize caching (Stagehand 2x/~30% already ships) or freshness/delta-repair (runtime nginx HIT 960/960) or semantic-resolve reconstruction where aliasing is orthogonal before revisiting economics. Frontier retrieval complementarity remains Graph's advantage at f=10. C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY remains HYPOTHESIS (bounded REJECTED for proxy setting only, not global falsification of all residual-novelty). MIXED outcome directs investigation to constant overhead (retrieval/verification not amortized, repair dominates, length still explains cost) rather than slope. No promotion; invest in kernel Jaccard/freshness/UNKNOWN calibration or richer cross-site DOM before re-testing.
estimated_cost: Low-moderate: 192 WebArena-Verified v2 tasks (36 families) x 6 conditions (SPIDER/COLD/INSTRUCTION/RAG-EMBED/STAGEHAND/TERX) + 3 controls ~1152-1350 deterministic resolve/_bind/verify trials plus TFIDF/embedding retrieval offline and Stagehand hash simulation. File-based fixtures (no Docker requirement for this file-based census; Docker/Playwright only if gpt-4o-mini steps measured). Wall-clock <30 min CPU proxy; if gpt-4o-mini 15 steps Playwright measured at 192*6*~2 browser calls ~2300 calls <90 min at 1280x720. Storage: per-task CSV ~1350 rows, registry JSONL, cost_config, traces. No LLM keys required for proxy isolation; ~$8-12 if real LLM measured. No large datasets committed.
expected_information_gain: Very high: First non-bijective, non-starved test of SPIDER's central economic promise after 2 consecutive MEASUREMENT_INVALID (bijective M=250+500*novelty rho=1, registry never consulted, UNKNOWN never exercised, baselines hit 0/100 at n=0). Either a valid positive (novelty-proportional compression rho>0.6 R2_delta>0.5 beating shipped Stagehand 2x/~30% and TERX 0-token at >0%) or a valid negative/MIXED (flat cost or no honest saving vs retrievable RAG/Stagehand/TERX) decisively changes product decision: (1) whether C-PRODUCT-ECON amortized economics scale-up to Docker/full-DOM + real LLM is justified vs premature, (2) whether parameterized inheritance justifies productization despite Stagehand caching dominance at exact repeat, (3) whether residual-novelty tracking holds beyond synthetic L=10 mock to WebArena family hold-out with family-stratified CIs. Resolves Director's flagged opportunity cost of 10+ narrow synthetic loops and the 44-deep frontier tunnel by delivering the neglected honest cost-vs-novelty measurement Frontier will complement with retrieval complementarity on same alias splits.
